facts.text: Regan, try some soup. Her room is freezing again, so we eat by the fire tonight and I call a priest in the morning.
facts.why: Chris never says this. Her real lines on the quote page include 'Hey, do me a favor, will ya? Tell me somethin' good.'
facts.fix: Hey, do me a favor, will ya? Tell me somethin' good.

fix_note.text: Hey, do me a favor, will ya? Tell me somethin' good.

facts.text: Karl's tray, before Burke starts on him.
facts.why: The script has Burke approaching Karl, who is carrying a tray of drinks at Chris's party, then Burke needling him about the Gestapo and calling him a Nazi bastard.
facts.fix: Passed round at Chris's party before Regan appears.

facts.text: Burke's drink. Mind the steps on the way out.
facts.why: Burke is the party guest with the line about an alien pubic hair in his drink, and Wikipedia has him found dead at the bottom of the steps under Regan's window.
facts.fix: Dennings was left with Regan that night. Mind the steps on the way out.

vibe.verdict: A hotel room service card from the MacNeil house is a sharp idea, and the pea soup, steps and cold room all land.
